evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse existing せっせと/せっせと; add sourced N2 level only.
rows.sourceNote: Existing industrious-effort lesson covers the source. Preserve its full teaching, title, reading, exclusions, scene metadata and images. Failed public-body extraction is not positive verification.

rows.mappingNote: New 接続/せつぞく article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive/intransitive connecting, transport services connecting, and grammatical abbreviation. Public transport usage qualifies raw changing-trains gloss; do not reduce every connection to a passenger transfer. セツ stays せつ, without small っ.

rows.mappingNote: New 瀬戸物/せともの article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Original Seto ware and general ceramic ware/crockery. 瀬戸 is a place name; 戸 contributes と, not literal door semantics. Search-only 瀬戸もの/セトモノ are recognized, not promoted.

source.waller_definition: by all means (with sense of not taking no for an answer)

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary ぜひとも article recognizing 是非とも/是非共.
rows.sourceNote: Emphatic ぜひ in wishes/invitations/requests. Raw not-taking-no wording does not impose coercion on every use; captured polite invitation supplies the qualification. Kana primary has no written kanji metadata.

rows.mappingNote: New 迫る/せまる article; source primary reading retained.
rows.sourceNote: Godan approach/imminence and strong pressing/demanding. Explain particles and 必要に迫られる; recognize rare 逼る and separate obsolete せる without replacing せまる.

rows.mappingNote: New ゼミ/ゼミ article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Abbreviation of German-derived ゼミナール. Small-group research/report/discussion; university focus is not an absolute location restriction or lecturer-only teaching format.

rows.mappingNote: New せめて minimum-wish adverb article; supplied entry 1006570 retained.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve raw offense/method-of-attack fields. Complete pinned adverb and separate noun families plus mixed public headings establish distinct identities. Also distinguish 攻めて, the verb's te-form.
rows.identityNote: Raw attack-method gloss is inconsistent with supplied adverb identity. Separate 攻め手 1675160 has that noun meaning; no invented source-ID correction or recovered compiler intent.

rows.mappingNote: New 攻める/せめる article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Ichidan attack/take-on transitive senses and colloquial bold/proactive intransitive use. Attested fashion example avoids literal attack. Compare 責める without denying shared origin.

rows.mappingNote: New セメント/セメント article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Construction binder, not finished concrete; distinguish hardening from merely drying. Direct existing concrete comparison becomes a link without changing its teaching.

rows.mappingNote: New 栓/せん article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Stopper/plug and flow-control valve/tap. Not every stopper is cork; valve-closing differs from pulling a bath plug. Direct 蛇口 and コック safeguards do not propagate from their old guard.

source.waller_definition: around,throughout,front and back,before and behind,before and after

rows.mappingNote: New 前後/ぜんご article; all eight selected senses recognized.
rows.sourceNote: Spatial/temporal pair, suffix approximation, order/context, consequences, approximate event time, out-of-order and close co-occurrence. Attachment examples separate Nの前後 from quantity+前後. 前後して need not mean exact simultaneity.

rows.mappingNote: New 洗剤/せんざい article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Cleaning agent/detergent; captured public definition includes soap and synthetic detergents. Keep absent-card 剤 in metadata; compare actual existing せっけん without absolute exclusion.

rows.mappingNote: New 全集/ぜんしゅう article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Complete works/collected series; public definition also covers genre/period collections. Not necessarily every unpublished item ever written or only one author's output.

rows.mappingNote: New 全身/ぜんしん article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Whole body/full-length and systemic modifier. Distinguish body extent from 力 supplied by a complete strength phrase; retain 身 despite its absent character card.

rows.mappingNote: New 扇子/せんす article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Folding fan, not same-sounding センス or nonfolding うちわ. 子 supplies ス here, not こ. Public redirect alone does not establish all details; pinned full principal/comparisons do.

rows.mappingNote: New 専制/せんせい article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Autocracy/despotism, with public arbitrary superior-control extension. Rare 擅制 recognition is not a recommended normal spelling. Useful reciprocal 専 at セン; not an academic major or teacher.

rows.mappingNote: New 先々月/せんせんげつ article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Calendar month before last, not a rolling sixty-day interval. Recognize 先先月, explain repeated 先/iteration mark, and link distinct calendar expressions without synonym guards.

rows.mappingNote: New 先々週/せんせんしゅう article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve blank source gloss. Pinned family establishes calendar week before last; failed public extraction is explicit. Recognize 先先週 and distinguish a rolling fourteen-day interval.

rows.mappingNote: New 先祖/せんぞ article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Ancestors/forebears, including family founder; not a specific grandparent or any senior colleague. 祖's ソ voices to ぞ in the whole word. Ordinary 親 ancestor sense motivates a bounded label precaution.

rows.mappingNote: New 先端/せんたん article; source identity retained.
rows.sourceNote: Physical tip/end and figurative forefront/leading edge; the tip need not be sharp. Recognize rare 尖端. Dot/focus/gist and summit comparisons require actual senses, not an isolated English point token.

inspectionStageAdvance.originalInspectionStatus: Prepared, not inspected; record completed actual reads separately.
inspectionStageAdvance.completedInspection: All 22 complete-family bundles, 19 existing-body bundles, 268 labels, 30 component records, 22 public capture records and four additional existing articles were actually read.
sourceMappingDecisions: Nineteen new articles and reused せっせと, adding only its sourced N2 level while preserving all stable metadata, teaching, exclusions and images.
せめて keeps supplied entry 1006570. The raw attack-method gloss is preserved but explicitly assigned to separate 攻め手 1675160 for contrast; compiler intent is not recovered.
Kana-primary ぜひとも explicitly recognizes 是非とも/是非共 without adding unwritten kanji to metadata.
Blank 先々週 gloss is preserved; the exact pinned entry supports the week-before-last meaning despite failed public-body extraction.
crossReferencePlan: Three primary reciprocal N2 pairs: 接/接続 at セツ, 戸/瀬戸物 at と in the place-derived name, and 専/専制 at セン.
Existing word references become narrow links where the new target is introduced; no baseline identities, titles, readings, exclusions or easier levels change.
inspectionStageAdvance.limits: Actual author read accounting, not independent review or runtime quiz proof. Principals are included, not counted twice, in the family union. Unselected existing bodies remain capture-only. No repository content changed at this stage.

quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer findings or reproduced quiz draws. Direct symmetric/nontransitive guards require actual label and sense assessment; shared topics or an indirect old guard do not suffice.

接続 considers actual connecting/joining/attachment/transport labels, including ordinary 連絡 and 接する senses. 間接's qualified indirect label is not treated as an unrestricted synonym. Continuation and joint labels warrant independent assessment rather than a topic clique.
瀬戸物 considers ceramic crockery against 食器/皿. The broader material and specific object categories remain differentiated; exclusions do not make every ceramic item tableware or every plate ceramic.
ぜひとも considers actual emphatic request/wish/certainty labels without assigning a prediction sense. It is not a rule that all adverbs are mutually interchangeable.
迫る considers approach and strong-demand/pressure senses. 責める's ordinary pressing sense is separate evidence, not its homophony with 攻める.
せめて considers actual minimum/only labels with the minimum-wish qualifier; upper-limit 精々 remains a contrast, not an automatic synonym. 以上's factual lower bound differs from wishing.
攻める considers attack and colloquial proactive senses. 叩く has an ordinary verbal-attack sense; shared conflict topics alone do not add every criticism word.
栓 directly safeguards 蛇口 and コック. Their existing mutual safeguard does not protect the new word.

前後 considers actual approximation, sequence/context, consequence, inversion and close-co-occurrence senses. It does not automatically equate one half of a coordinate front/back or before/after pair with the whole pair. Generic rough first-pass 一応 is not automatically a numerical approximation.
洗剤 includes soap in the public definition, so せっけん is directly protected; related washing actions and cleaning tools are not synonyms of the substance.
全集 considers actual collection labels; generic gathering/action/set labels need independent scope assessment rather than transitive expansion.
全身 considers the actual body/whole labels, not merely every occurrence of all. Mind-and-body 心身 is not equated with the whole physical body.
先祖/親 considers the latter's unmarked ancestor sense rather than merely a child-parent family topic. Grandparent subtypes are not automatically equivalent to ancestry as a whole.
先端 considers actual tip/end/top labels. 点's broad point label warrants independent assessment; focus/gist/emphasis labels are not automatically a physical tip or leading edge.

セメント, ゼミ, 扇子, 専制 and the two calendar words have no new guards. Related materials, course activities, objects/actions, homophones and different calendar periods are not automatically synonyms. Absence of guards is not exhaustive certification.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty source rows map nineteen new articles and a level-only reused せっせと. All raw CSV fields, baseline identities/readings/titles/exclusions and easier levels are preserved.
せめて retains supplied adverb entry 1006570 despite the mismatched attack-method gloss; separate 攻め手 is 1675160. Source selection does not recover compiler intent.
432 families/1068 senses include the twenty principals/36 senses, not an additional twenty. Thirty component records support associations, not invented etymology.
Three primary reciprocal pairs are 接/接続, 戸/瀬戸物 and 専/専制. Kana-primary ぜひとも alias navigation does not inflate that count. No character metadata/strokes change.
Seven existing word articles gain links only; せっせと adds only sourced N2. Review the unchanged reused teaching only for the claimed source coverage, not as a newly authored whole article.

Only 113 existing full bodies were inspected; other captured bodies remain capture-only. All twenty-two public attempts were inspected, but only twenty contain lexical bodies. せっせと/先々週 failures and the 扇子 redirect remain qualified.

The blind derivative omits only quizGuardRationale. All captures and source-access observations are author-executed; reviewers must state their own actual scope. CLEAN/validators are bounded, not exhaustive linguistic or runtime-quiz certification.

adjudications.decision: Add せめて/くらい using the ordinary minimum-request sense in particle 1154340:2 and desire/hope sense 1006570:1. The actual approximately/extent label does not erase an ordinary secondary sense; rank noun 1155400 and adjective 1154330 remain distinct. No unrestricted substitution or transitive guard inference.
攻 is read せ, but the ichidan stem of 攻める is せめ. Distinguish reading/okurigana and inflectional boundaries, preserving the already-correct forms.
Add 先端/トップ for actual leading-edge and leading-position labels with 1388110:2 and 1085030:2. 頂上's existing guard does not propagate. This does not equate every ranking or leader with a physical tip.
Add ゼミ/授業 based on the seminar class and actual class/lesson label, 1075160 and 1330290. The broader title is defensible for a seminar class, not proof that every class is a seminar.

Add 専制/支配 for the actual broad rule/control label against autocratic rule, using 1389810 and 1310270:1. Preserve the specificity of arbitrary concentrated power rather than calling every control autocracy.
Add 全集/シリーズ using 1395340:1 complete series and 1062910:1 series, and actual collected-series/series titles. Not every related series is a complete collected edition.

Remove throughout from the negative warning and preserve the context-dependent reversed-order statement. The old wording did not literally define 前後 as throughout, but could imply a supported use. Raw source fields and 1392910:1-8 selection stay unchanged.

adjudications.status: optional precaution adopted; not an established initial defect
adjudications.decision: Add direct attack/take-on versus fight/compete label protection using complete 1279130 and 1596960. Warfare/contest overlap supports a conservative quiz precaution, not erasing offensive versus defensive fighting, grammatical transitivity or resisting adversity.

Do not expand non-N2 backlinks, seminar/German wording, weather-prediction wording or 専制する frequency claims solely to prolong review. Do not replace the qualified 前後 reading note with always ぜんご: separate archaic まえしりえ 2629970 exists. The old 再来月/先月 link gap is outside the changed passage.

correctionEvidence.modelDiversity: Complete reports including Optional, Limits and per-file notes were compared. No shared initial actionable defect. GPT uniquely identified the particle minimum-request gap and stem terminology. Claude identified four broader-label gaps and the warning's possible implication, plus the adopted optional fight-label precaution. GPT reported all-family and 94 comparison-body reads; Claude disclosed targeted family reading and narrower old-body scope. Complementary observations, not a controlled benchmark, ranking or proof of bias elimination. Confirmations share author hypotheses.
correctionEvidence.limits: Author adjudication, not reviewer confirmation. Initial inspection evidence, author guard hypotheses and all original source/family/selection fields remain. Seven new cards change; twelve other new cards, reused teaching/level, three kanji edits, seven old links and all twenty mappings are unchanged. Thirteen duplicate families are checked, not recounted. No new public retrieval or runtime quiz draw is claimed.

finalDispositions.GPT F01: Resolved: both accept the direct せめて/くらい safeguard, grounded in minimum-request overlap with complete particle 1154340:2, not the adjective or rank noun. No transitive exclusion inference.
finalDispositions.GPT F02: Resolved: both accept the corrected kanji reading せ, written okurigana める and ichidan stem せめ, retaining existing correct forms.
finalDispositions.Claude F1: Resolved: both accept 先端/トップ for actual leading-edge/leading-position labels, not through existing 頂上 protection.
finalDispositions.Claude F2: Resolved: both accept ゼミ/授業 as a conservative class-label safeguard while preserving the narrower seminar format.
finalDispositions.Claude F3: Resolved: both accept 専制/支配 as a conservative rule/control-label safeguard, preserving arbitrary autocratic rule as narrower.
finalDispositions.Claude F4: Resolved: both accept 全集/シリーズ for complete/collected-series versus series labels without universal Japanese substitution.
finalDispositions.Claude F5: Resolved: both accept removing the negative throughout warning and retaining the contextual reversed-order caution. This improves comprehensibility without concluding that the original explicitly defined a throughout sense.
finalDispositions.Claude optional 攻める/戦う: Adopted and supported by both as a conservative attack/take-on versus fight/compete label safeguard, not retrospectively a proven initial defect.
finalDispositions.Claude optional always-ぜんご: Withdrawn by Claude after checking separate archaic まえしりえ entry 2629970. No unrestricted reading claim added.
finalDispositions.Claude optional uncommon-する: Withdrawn by Claude: 1389810 recognizes suru and no frequency evidence supports rarity.
finalDispositions.optional: Additional non-N2 backlinks, wording expansions, a せめて collocation and the pre-existing 再来月/先月 link gap remain nonblocking. No post-confirmation teaching changes.

confirmationEvidence.scope: Both original reviewers completely reread all seven affected new cards, the actual correction patch, seventeen complete corrective families and six complete old comparison bodies. Thirteen unchanged per-source judgments (twelve new cards plus reused せっせと) were inherited. Both spot-checked the three reciprocal kanji edits, seven old links and reused level. GPT reread all twenty TSV and compact mappings; Claude inspected twenty mapping rows and fully read N2:908/N2:912, inheriting the remaining detailed mapping judgments. Each supplies exactly twenty individual all-CLEAN three-facet article rows on the same corrected commit.
confirmationEvidence.limits: All four complete native reports, exact prompts/models/private-path scope, original-session continuity, snapshots/patches/derivatives and zero edits were author-authenticated. Git/hash checks are author-executed, not reviewer-executed. No live quiz draws, fresh confirmation retrievals, native-speaker certification or controlled model benchmark. Initial reviews were blind; confirmations shared correction hypotheses. No reviewer processes remain.
